approaches.name: Collect the non-zeros, then pad
approaches.intuition: Build a new list of the non-zero values in order, then add as many zeros as were skipped.

approaches.name: Write pointer in place
approaches.intuition: Keep every non-zero value in order by writing it at the next free position; everything after the last write becomes zero.
pitfalls: Swapping instead of copying also works, but do not swap an element with itself needlessly.
Order of the non-zero values must not change.

talkTrackMd: Show the simple filter first, then the in-place variant. Explain that the write pointer always sits on the first position that is either zero or already processed.
